title: Modified Qiagen Gel Extraction with MinElute Spin Column
author: Daniel J. Richter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ivdce26

steps.title: Dissolve Gel Slice
steps.instruction: Add 3 volumes of Buffer QG to the gel slice (e.g., 300 μL per 0.1 g of gel) and incubate at 50ºC for 10 minutes or until the gel slice is dissolved.

substeps.instruction: Mix the sample every 2-3 minutes during incubation.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 1 gel volume of isopropanol and mix by inverting.

steps.title: Load Sample onto Column
steps.instruction: Place 800 μL of sample into a QIAquick column within a collection tube and spin at maximum speed for 1 minute.

substeps.instruction: If any sample remains, continue spinning through the column and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer QG
steps.instruction: Add 500 μL of buffer QG, spin for 1 minute, and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer PE
steps.instruction: Wash with 750 μL of buffer PE, let stand for 2-5 minutes, spin for 1 minute, and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Remove Residual Liquid
steps.instruction: Clean the top and bottom edges of the collection tube by pipetting out remaining liquid using a P20 pipette.

steps.title: Dry Column (Hinge Inwards)
steps.instruction: Place the column with the hinge facing INWARDS and spin for 1 minute at maximum speed.

steps.title: Dry Column (Hinge Outwards)
steps.instruction: Place the column with the hinge facing OUTWARDS and spin for 1 minute at maximum speed.

steps.title: Prepare for Elution
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube and add 10.3 μL of water.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 minute to elute.
